title: Autoheal drafting answer
description: The only thing the drafting model returns, requested through structured outputs. Two kinds. rule_insert adds at most 8 lines of markdown under an existing heading of one of the candidate files supplied in the prompt. skip declines. The model never returns a diff, an id or a fingerprint: code derives the id from the signature, checks target_path and anchor_heading against the real file, and builds the diff itself. draft_proposals.py replaces the target_path enum with the candidate paths of each call and strips the keywords the structured-outputs subset rejects (maxLength and the like); it enforces those limits after the parse.

target_path.description: Repo-relative path of one candidate file. Replaced per call with the candidate paths.

anchor_heading.description: Exact text of an existing heading in target_path. The insert goes at the end of that section.

insert_markdown.description: The rule text to insert: 8 lines or fewer, in the voice of the file.

reason.description: Why no rule line would have prevented these occurrences.
